title: text_exact and label_exact join role_exact
body: click_by/fill_by/get_text_by gained text_exact and label_exact flags mirroring role_exact — matching stayed substring-by-default the whole time, this just adds an opt-in for exact instead of leaving you to hand-craft a selector.

title: macro_lint catches an impossible field before replay
body: macro_lint now catches a field a macro action can't actually accept before you replay it, instead of a live TypeError days later.

title: restart --help says what the sweep actually kills
body: restart --help says plainly what the browser sweep actually kills (every Playwright browser on the machine, protected or not), and macro_lint stopped warning on ordinary navigate URLs.
